Market today: A clear risk-on mood. Easing Middle East tensions and a pause in U.S./Iran fighting have sent oil prices sinking and stock futures rallying. This de-escalation is a strong positive for growth-oriented tech and chip names, as it reduces uncertainty and supports higher valuations.

Your holdings: SOXL (-46.24%) and SPAL (-52.96%) are both leveraged ETFs with massive drawdowns and "default stops" that aren't protecting capital. SPAL is a brand-new, very volatile IPO. QQQ (-4.26%) and QQQI (-6.52%) are also marked SELL and are nearing their respective stops. Remember, margin amplifies these drops.

Watch: Keep a very close eye on your stops for QQQ, QQQI, and SMH. Also, monitor for any shifts in the current geopolitical calm, as it's the primary market driver today.

Bottom line: Prioritize aggressive risk management on your leveraged and underperforming positions; don't let relief rallies distract from deep drawdowns.
plays: SOXL (-46.24%) and SPAL (-52.96%), both leveraged, have critical drawdowns. Their default stops are not protective; re-evaluate immediately to preserve capital.
QQQ (-4.26%) and QQQI (-6.52%) are marked SELL and are very close to their stops at 670 and 52. Be prepared to execute these stops.
SMH is down 11.82% and marked TRIM. Consider reducing exposure to manage risk in your chip concentration.
